{{Recipe summary
| Category = Pancake recipes
| Servings = 4–6
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{Recipe}}

==Ingredients==

=== Wet ===
* 40 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 3 medium-size ripe [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]]
* 3 standard [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 375 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] whole [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]

=== Dry ===
* 300 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] [[Cookbook:Self-rising Flour|self-raising flour]] (or 300 grams [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]] + 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]])
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] soft [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]

==Procedure==
# Melt the butter in a medium-size heat-safe [[Cookbook:Mixing Bowl|mixing bowl]].
# Add the bananas, and mash the bananas and butter together with a [[Cookbook:Potato Masher|potato masher]].
# Add the eggs and continue to mash until smooth.
# Gradually stir in the milk with a wooden spoon.
# In a separate large bowl, [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] together the dry ingredients.
# Slowly mix the wet ingredients into the dry to get a [[Cookbook:Batter|batter]]. 
# Heat a nonstick [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] over medium heat.
# For each round of frying, grease the pan with a little extra butter. Pour about ⅓ cup of batter onto the pan for each pancake, making sure they don't run into each other.
# Cook the pancakes on on medium-low heat for about 3 minutes on each side until the side is lightly browned. You can tell if it's time to turn the pancake if you can see bubbles on the other side.
# Flip the pancakes using a spatula, and cook through on the other side.
# Remove the pancakes from the pan, and repeat the cooking process with the remaining batter.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If using salted butter, omit the extra salt in the ingredients.
